mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.biz_type, t.biz_id, t.biz_no, t.movement_id, t.material_id, t.warehouse_id, t.biz_date, t.qty, t.unit_cost, t.amount, t.balance_qty, t.balance_cost, t.period FROM (SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, movement_id, material_id, warehouse_id, biz_date, qty, unit_cost, amount, balance_qty, balance_cost, period FROM cost_flow WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) t FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cost_flow WHERE period >= #{fromPeriod} AND period <= #{toPeriod}
mapper.select: SELECT mat.material_id, bm.code AS material_code, bm.name AS material_name, IFNULL(ob.balance_qty, 0) AS begin_qty, IFNULL(ob.balance_cost, 0) AS begin_amount, IFNULL(iq.in_qty, 0) AS in_qty, IFNULL(iq.in_amount, 0) AS in_amount, IFNULL(oq.out_qty, 0) AS out_qty, IFNULL(oq.out_amount, 0) AS out_amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT material_id FROM cost_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND period <= #{period}) mat LEFT JOIN base_material bm ON bm.id = mat.material_id LEFT JOIN ( /* 每物料取期间前最后一行运行余额作为期初 */ SELECT c.material_id, c.balance_qty, c.balance_cost FROM cost_flow c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.period < #{period} AND c.id = (SELECT MAX(c2.id) FROM cost_flow c2 WHERE c2.deleted = 0 AND c2.material_id = c.material_id AND c2.period < #{period}) ) ob ON ob.material_id = mat.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS in_qty, SUM(amount) AS in_amount FROM cost_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND period = #{period} AND qty > 0 GROUP BY material_id ) iq ON iq.material_id = mat.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, SUM(-qty) AS out_qty, SUM(-amount) AS out_amount FROM cost_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND period = #{period} AND qty < 0 GROUP BY material_id ) oq ON oq.material_id = mat.material_id

SELECT period, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN qty > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN qty < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN biz_type = 'SAL_OUT' AND qty < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sal_out_cost, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN biz_type = 'PROD_USE' AND qty < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prod_use_cost FROM cost_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND period >= #{fromPeriod} AND period <= #{toPeriod} GROUP BY period

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.balance_cost), 0) FROM cost_flow c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.period < #{fromPeriod} AND c.id = (SELECT MAX(c2.id) FROM cost_flow c2 WHERE c2.deleted = 0 AND c2.material_id = c.material_id AND c2.period < #{fromPeriod})
